name: Jellyfin Helper
description: Cleans up orphaned .trickplay folders, empty media folders, and orphaned subtitles. Repairs broken .strm files and symlinks. Scheduled Seerr cleanup of unavailable Overseerr/Jellyseerr media requests. Provides media library statistics with video/audio codec analysis, resolution/container breakdown, dynamic range detection (HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HLG, SDR), health checks (embedded subtitle detection), caching, ML-powered smart recommendations per user with ensemble scoring (heuristic, learned, neural), Seerr Discovery for personalized external content suggestions with one-click request submission, user activity insights with play count and completion tracking, library insights (largest directories & recent changes), historical trends, trash/recycle bin with detailed contents UI, multi-instance Arr stack integration (up to 3 Radarr + 3 Sonarr) with connection testing and collapsible UI, plugin-specific log viewer with download and filtering, unsaved settings protection, and a multi-language 8-tab dashboard (en, de, fr, es, pt, zh, tr, sv).
overview: Automated cleanup (trickplay, empty folders, subtitles, link repair for .strm & symlinks), Seerr request cleanup, Seerr Discovery (personalized external content recommendations with one-click requests), media statistics with codec/health/dynamic-range analysis, ML-powered smart recommendations per user, user activity insights, library insights, trends, trash bin, plugin log viewer, multi-instance Arr integration, unsaved settings alert, and multi-language 8-tab dashboard.

versions.changelog: v2.1.0.6: Diagnostics for reverse-proxy / WAF-blocked config saves. Added GET /JellyfinHelper/Ping liveness endpoint. Configuration model-binding and validation errors are now logged to the plugin log (source "API", level WARN) instead of silently returning 400. Frontend save handler now classifies errors (network / proxy / server / unauthorized) and surfaces the HTTP status and body snippet to the console, with an automatic Ping follow-up to distinguish "backend unreachable" from "backend reachable, payload rejected". 2322 tests.

v2.1.0.5: Fix StackOverflow on circular symlinks in directory scan. Fix IOException on long trash path names. Added Swedish (sv) language. Exclude Libraries multi-select dropdown. Trash folder browser. Trash path change dialog (move/delete content on path change). Enhanced trash path validation. Upgraded to Jellyfin 10.11.10. 2318 tests.
v2.1.0.4: Fix MissingMethodException for IUserManager.Users.

v2.1.0.3: Add TMDB and Seerr deep links on discovery card flip-back (opens system browser on mobile). Fix 400 Bad Request when submitting discovery requests on Seerr instances with 0-based server IDs. Fix duplicate quality profiles in selection popup for users with multiple root folders. Add graceful error handling for Jellyfin version incompatibility in watch history collection. 2206 tests
v2.1.0.2: Improved Discovery Sidebar Navigation - tab layout can show more than 5 recommendations in one row now. Automatically reloading next recommendation after one was dismissed or requested.
v2.1.0.1: Fix Discovery sidebar navigation - tab is now found dynamically by container index regardless of user-configured tab name, instead of relying on exact text match.

v2.1.0.0: Seerr Discovery - personalized external content recommendations via Overseerr/Jellyseerr with ensemble scoring, one-click request submission, parental rating enforcement, language-based discovery, and Arr library exclusion. 2190 tests.

v2.0.0.3: Instance-based Arr config (legacy removed), persistent language/log-level. Recommendations add audio language & creation date, subtitle language affinity, collection progression boost; meaningful-interaction watched predicates. Centralized popularity scoring, richer training features (31-feature vector), series aggregation, weight schema bump. Neural MLP upgraded to 4-hidden-layer architecture (31→48→24→12→6→1, ~3097 params). Training refactored into TrainingDataBuilder + TrainingFeatureComputer. A/B testing cohort infrastructure with deterministic user bucketing and adaptive sigmoid midpoint. 2124 tests.

v2.0.0.2: Replaced decorative emojis with Material Symbols font icons for consistent cross-platform rendering. Standardized dash punctuation. Fixed subtitle orphan detection to avoid false deletions. 2110 tests.
v2.0.0.1: UI improvement - Recommendations and Watch Activity sections in the Discover tab are now collapsible. Collapsible state is preserved on user switch. 2032 tests.

v2.0.0.0: New Discover tab using an ensemble ML model to provide tailored content recommendations. This update also introduces granular activity tracking and improved system cleanup for uninstallation of this plugin. 2032 tests.

v1.2.1.0: Statistics refactored to use Jellyfin MediaStream metadata (replaces filename parsing). Dynamic range detection (HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HLG, SDR). Extended resolution classification (8K, 1440p, SD). Differentiated audio codecs (TrueHD Atmos, DTS-X, DTS-HD MA, EAC3 Atmos). Donut chart enhancements with dynamic range visualization. Library Insights in Trends tab (top-10 largest directories, recently added/changed items, per-library size breakdown with 15-min cache). Performance improvement via per-item video stream caching. Documentation updated.

v1.2.0.0: Seerr Cleanup Task (scheduled cleanup of unavailable Overseerr/Jellyseerr media requests), Unsaved Settings Alert (dirty-tracking with discard/save/cancel dialog), Collapsible Arr/Seerr sections with dynamic instance count, Auto-Save Dropdowns (task modes + language save instantly with checkmark/cross indicator), Link Repair enhanced with symlink support, Auto-Init Scan on first visit, Scroll Position Restore after language change and backup import, 4-part versioning, meta.json fixes.
v1.1.0: Performance optimizations for GrowthTimelineService and BackupService, refactored monolith services, improved cross-platform compatibility, Trends UI enhancements.

v1.0.9: Removed legacy statistics history (replaced by growth timeline), removed Export/CSV endpoints, new StatisticsCacheService, legacy history file cleanup, growth timeline interpolation & deduplication, reduced backup size limit, 957 tests.
v1.0.8: Project restructure, bug fix for Jellyfin versions below 10.11.8, backup/restore data, enhanced TrendChart, relocated download buttons, responsive Data Tree for touch devices.

v1.0.7: Added i18n support (EN, DE, FR, ES, PT, TR, ZH), scheduled task for cleaning empty media folders, trend chart visualization, configurable intervals, and automatic plugin data directory creation.
Exclude trash folders from media statistics, fix false positives for orphaned TV show metadata directories, fix trash disable dialog in UI.

Multi-instance Arr support (up to 3 Radarr + 3 Sonarr), Arr connection test endpoint, persisted latest scan results (survives restarts), post-cleanup statistics scan, embedded subtitle detection in health checks, video vs music audio codec split, codec file path tracking with clickable drill-down, trash contents detail API, trash folder management UI, trash disable dialog, other file tracking, 6-tab modular dashboard (Overview/Codecs/Health/Trends/Settings/Arr), modular CSS/JS build system, XSS protection, boxset/collection health check skipping, comprehensive README rewrite, 573 tests.

Added STRM file repair task, unified TaskMode system (Activate/DryRun/Deactivate per task), single master HelperCleanupTask replacing separate scheduled tasks, fixed ConfigVersion not preserved on settings save, fixed DI resolution for System.IO.Abstractions.IFileSystem, updated README, 315 tests.

Fixed plugin logo 404 (logo.png now included as physical file in release ZIP with meta.json imagePath), fixed SanitizeFileName null-char handling, removed duplicate Cleanup Statistics UI section, removed unused GetThumbImage method, 244 tests.

Fixed subtitle false positives (explicit ISO 639 allowlists instead of naive 2-3 letter heuristic), moved SubtitleFlags/KnownLanguageCodes to MediaExtensions, ArrIntegrationService now uses IHttpClientFactory, CleanupTrackingService thread-safety with lock, specific exception handling, removed _ = ex anti-pattern, 244 tests.
Fixed config page not loading (script/style tags moved inside page div), plugin now visible in Jellyfin sidebar menu with EnableInMainMenu, updated test count to 212.

Initial release with trickplay folder cleanup, empty media folder cleanup, orphaned subtitle cleaner, media statistics dashboard, audio codec analysis, export (JSON/CSV), historical trends, trash/recycle bin, Arr stack integration (Radarr/Sonarr), multi-language dashboard (en/de/fr/es/pt/zh/tr), library include/exclude lists, and 196 tests.
